subject.title: Bound plugin bundle command file reads with size cap

question: Should installed plugin bundle command Markdown be subject to the proposed 1 MiB hard limit, with oversized commands skipped after a warning?
rationale: The code correctly implements the selected policy, but choosing a permanent cap changes the upgrade contract for existing user-installed command content and cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Confirm the 1 MiB command limit
options.body: Accept the current bounded-read behavior, warning, and sibling continuation as the supported installed-command contract.

options.title: Set a different command-content policy
options.body: Choose a larger cap or another bounded handling rule, then update the constant, proof, and regression coverage to match.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 1 MiB command limit
recommendation.body: Accept the current bounded-read behavior, warning, and sibling continuation as the supported installed-command contract.
